defs.def: to want sth or want to do sth 想要；想做

ex.s: fancied abstract paintingD. exhibited child paintings
ex.t: 喜欢抽象画D. 展示儿童画作

defs.def: to be sexually attracted to sb 对 … 有性幻想；倾慕
to think that you are very popular, attractive or intelligent 自负；自命不凡
to like the idea of being sth or to believe, often wrongly, that you are sth 自认为是；自命为
（表示惊奇或震惊）真想不到，竟然
to think that sb/sth will win or be successful at sth, especially in a race 认为 … 会成功；（尤指速度竞赛）认为 … 要赢
to believe or imagine sth 认为；想像
something that you imagine; your imagination 想像的事物；想像（力）
a feeling that you would like to have or to do sth 想要；爱好
a small decorated cake 花色小蛋糕
unusually complicated, often in an unnecessary way; intended to impress other people 异常复杂的；太花哨的

ex.s: The film looks like a fairly typical historical film without fancy special effects, and it is made enjoyable by the performances of the main actors.
ex.t: 这部电影看起来像一部相当典型的历史片，没有花哨的特效，主演们的表演让它变得很精彩。

ex.s: I saw a lot of people wearing fancy Mongolian robes.
ex.t: 我看到很多人穿着漂亮的蒙古袍。

defs.def: with a lot of decorations or bright colours 尤指小物件
expensive or connected with an expensive way of life 昂贵的；奢华的

ex.s: One of my favourite episodes was Mr Bean in a fancy restaurant.
ex.t: 我最喜欢的一集是憨豆先生在一家高档餐厅里。

ex.s: Read the rest of Text 1 and focus on the two scenes of Mr Bean at the fancy restaurant.
ex.t: 阅读文本 1 的其余部分，重点关注憨豆先生在高档餐厅里的两个场景。

ex.s: Why does Mr Bean go to a fancy restaurant on this particular day?
ex.t: 憨豆先生为什么要在这一天去高级餐厅？

chunks.cn: 昂贵的餐馆 / 昂贵的特殊的
